test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
​​​Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/571fcf23d92ab45248de38cfb57b7ce82c00f4a597f6f7500cd5a3b4988a0377.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -7, +2.

1. HD-AF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f08dfd00532b3ab0775357c97317e801a720279a93d946555c0fb41a4feb051f.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -7, +2.
2. PL-IM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7d87a48f63047142c55b36f8d61d46377e128c9ce9933e5fe932f01cd431f03.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -7, +2.
3. MI-FK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6869f60e84d9e5d9d09b8382ea3a943af63ddcec735b1404b65b4ecbd1b11af.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -7, +2.
4. JF-CH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/342beafb0820dce3bbd5893b3d8f12283698acfaea67f7a43416c24e42599747.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -7, +2.

Thus, PL-IM is the odd one out.
Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**"
